method: Recovered original176 composite claims and all linked independent semantic reviews; verified IDs, artifact hashes and original reviewed-document identities. Fresh closure semantic source checks and independently reviewed corrections supplement the recovered reviews. Identity automation is not a second semantic audit and never creates an independent reviewer. Current documents use full content hashes; final delivery commit is bound by the lead validation packet.
important_limits: A priority on a claim describes consequence if wrong, not an unresolved P0/P1 finding.
The recovered zero review-or-identity gaps was an evidence coverage statement, not proof of absence of semantic defects. Closure found and corrected additional defects.
Original source/runtime/owner acceptance scopes are not expanded. External URLs are locators, not freshly fetched or content-hashed receipts.
Changed documents retain original review for unchanged content plus the explicitly linked independent closure review of changed claims.
New closure corrections remain in amendment/source-review files and are not invented rows used to inflate the recovered176 count.

original_document_checks.basis: Recovered later original audit artifact bytes
